name: Scarlet Spider — Ben Reilly
look: Red bodysuit, sleeveless blue hoodie, large dark spider
moves: Impact web cocoons set up a launch-and-yank combo
Stinger shot interrupts one dangerous enemy
tradeoff: Setup beats raw damage; bosses resist repeat binds.

name: Spider-Man 2099 — classic
look: Dark blue body, bold red skull-like spider, angular red mask
moves: Talon rake → rising launch → descending claw slam
Venom finisher briefly stuns a grabbed enemy
tradeoff: Committed attacks hit hard but leave a punishable recovery.

name: Scarlet Spider — Kaine
look: Black and red body, red mask, dark lenses
moves: Adhesion grab pulls an enemy into a heavy slam
Short rage burst strengthens close-range finishers
tradeoff: Short reach; aggressive finishers expose him to crowds.

name: Sensational Spider-Man — Ben Reilly
look: Red and blue, large flowing chest spider, external wrist gear
moves: Web rebound bounces an enemy back into the combo
Successful dodge replenishes a little web capacity
tradeoff: Rewards movement and timing rather than standing mash combos.

name: Spider-Man 2099 — white
look: White armor panels, dark undersuit, red accents
moves: Airfoil glide ends in a directional dive attack
Pulse trap launches clustered enemies
tradeoff: Gliding and traps need cooldowns; movement must respect room geometry.

name: Superior Spider-Man
look: Red and black, large black emblem, optional mechanical limbs
moves: Spider drone marks a priority target
Precision hits on the marked target build a finisher
tradeoff: Changing targets loses the setup; autonomous drones are a later experiment.

name: Iron Spider — comic
look: Metallic red and gold, mechanical spider legs
moves: Mechanical arms parry into a launcher
Radial arm sweep creates breathing room
tradeoff: Extra articulated arms need model and animation work.

name: Iron Spider — MCU
look: Red, blue and gold armor, four back-mounted legs
moves: Arm-assisted air grab ends in a slam
Armored landing briefly resists interruption
tradeoff: Heavy recovery prevents armored moves becoming permanent invulnerability.

name: Spider-Armor Mk I
look: Silver armor plates over a black base
moves: Brace against a hit, then retaliate with a counterpunch
Heavy shoulder charge breaks a guard
tradeoff: Slower acceleration and fewer dodge cancels.

name: Spider-Armor Mk II
look: Black armor with a yellow spider
moves: Brief projectile guard turns a shot into counter energy
Armored uppercut punishes ranged attackers
tradeoff: Guard is directional and timed; melee can still interrupt.

name: Spider-Armor Mk III — Ends of the Earth
look: Bulky red armor with large pale eye pieces
moves: Choose a short resistance mode
Store blocked damage for one heavy release
tradeoff: One resistance at a time, with a visible recovery window.

name: Spider-Armor Mk IV
look: Glossy red and black, luminous green lenses and emblem
moves: Build a small adaptive shield through varied attacks
Swap between a bind gadget and a knockback gadget
tradeoff: Repeating the same attack stops charging the shield.

name: Velocity
look: Sleek blue-gray armor with red lines
moves: Sprint speed strengthens a rushing strike
Wall-run kick transfers momentum into an air combo
tradeoff: Power drops when movement stops; no uncontrolled speed through doors.

name: Anti-Ock
look: Dark armored body, bright yellow emblem and lenses
moves: Timed counter interrupts a heavy attacker
Gadget overcharge briefly strengthens a web pull
tradeoff: Limited charges; a missed counter creates a long opening.

name: Aaron Aikman armor
look: Segmented red and blue mechanical armor
moves: Booster uppercut starts a high air chain
Lock-on web projectile sets up a dash follow-up
tradeoff: Boost fuel limits repeated air launches.

name: Cyborg Spider-Man
look: Classic suit with a conspicuous mechanical arm and eye gear
moves: Arm cannon staggers an enemy at range
Mechanical-arm crush ends a short melee string
tradeoff: Cannon wind-up and mechanical silhouette need extra work.

name: Advanced Suit
look: Red and blue with a large white spider
moves: Web bomb scatters a small group
Air bounce keeps one enemy in a controlled juggle
tradeoff: Broad options without the strongest damage or longest stun.

name: Advanced Suit 2.0
look: Refined red and blue panels with a bold white spider
moves: Perfect dodge charges a combo finisher
Slingshot strike closes distance into a launch
tradeoff: Poorly timed dodges earn no extra resource.

name: Secret War
look: Dark blue and red with thin light accents
moves: Short shock burst interrupts a surrounding group
Marked enemy takes extra combo stagger
tradeoff: Interruption has a cooldown and should not lock down bosses.

name: Big Time stealth — green
look: Black suit, luminous green lenses and spider
moves: Brief camouflage enables an opening strike
Silent web trap binds one unaware enemy
tradeoff: Cloaking breaks on attack; enemy awareness rules are unconfirmed.

name: Big Time — red variant
look: Black suit with luminous red accents
moves: Sonic pulse breaks a crowd's attack rhythm
Pulse → web yank → kick creates a control combo
tradeoff: Short range and cooldown keep it from clearing every room instantly.

name: Spider-Man Noir
look: Black mask, dark coat or vest, pale goggle lenses
moves: Ambush strike briefly disables one target
Close counter rewards precise defensive timing
tradeoff: Coat geometry and actual stealth behavior are separate challenges.

name: Spider-Punk
look: Red mask, punk vest, spikes and guitar-inspired details
moves: Beat-timed attacks build a stronger combo ending
Guitar shockwave knocks back nearby enemies
tradeoff: Missing the rhythm resets momentum; a guitar needs a later prop animation.

name: Future Foundation
look: White and black, clean high-contrast emblem
moves: Choose protection or web efficiency for a short period
Adaptive burst removes one temporary negative effect
tradeoff: Cannot keep both modes active; status semantics are unconfirmed.

name: Negative Suit
look: Inverted dark-and-light colors with a pale emblem
moves: Pull a group together, then push it outward
Charge a polarity strike through alternating attacks
tradeoff: Small radius and setup time prevent effortless crowd loops.

name: Spirit Spider
look: Ghostly pale body, skeletal motif and flame effects
moves: A short flame trail punishes pursuing enemies
Ghost-fire uppercut adds a brief burn
tradeoff: Fire/status logic and effects are ambitious; cap concurrent particles.

name: Fear Itself
look: Dark armor with bright bands and heavy gauntlets
moves: Lightning uppercut launches one target
Charged ground strike creates a small shockwave
tradeoff: Slow wind-up and resource cost balance the wide attacks.

name: Captain Universe / Cosmic Spider-Man
look: Starry blue body with a distinctive pale head pattern
moves: Charged cosmic shot pierces a short enemy line
Gravity lift creates an air-combo opening
tradeoff: Large energy cost and weak uncharged attacks; best treated as a later bonus suit.

name: Classic symbiote
look: Black suit with a large white spider and white eyes
moves: Tendril sweep extends melee reach
Symbiote grab pulls an enemy into a heavy finisher
tradeoff: Build on the existing black-form foundation before inventing more states.

name: Anti-Venom
look: White body with dark eyes, emblem and organic accents
moves: Timed counter restores a small amount of health
Cleansing burst interrupts surrounding symbiote enemies
tradeoff: Healing requires successful defense and a cooldown, avoiding unlimited sustain.

name: Carnage-inspired
look: Red organic body with jagged black tendrils
moves: Tendril flurry creates a rapid multi-hit string
Finisher applies a short damage-over-time effect
tradeoff: Weak defense and status resistance for bosses; a custom themed design.

name: Spider-Man Unlimited
look: Dark red and blue high-tech suit, large back emblem
moves: Short scan highlights a nearby threat or collectible
Cloak-assisted air dash repositions for a strike
tradeoff: Scan requires object/UI discovery; cape and stealth come later.

name: Dusk
look: Almost featureless black costume
moves: Shadow dash slips past an enemy
Brief air float changes the timing of a dive kick
tradeoff: Dash cooldown and limited airtime prevent bypassing room boundaries.

name: Ricochet
look: Light hair or headpiece, dark mask, blue and white outfit
moves: Wall-bounce strike rebounds into an air attack
Ricocheting web pellet hits a second nearby target
tradeoff: Ricochets need target limits and readable trajectories.

name: Hornet
look: Purple and yellow tech suit, wing or jet gear
moves: Short hover enables a stinger volley
Dive-in strike spends the remaining hover charge
tradeoff: A small fuel budget keeps flight from skipping platforming.

name: Prodigy
look: Gold armor with a broad heroic silhouette
moves: Heavy charging punch breaks a defensive stance
Drop kick creates a short radial knockback
tradeoff: Low air agility and long recovery; armor silhouette is optional later work.

name: Homemade — MCU
look: Red hoodie and mask, blue casual layers
moves: Improvised web snare sets up a trip attack
Close-range web burst creates room to dodge
tradeoff: Limited reach, but inexpensive setup moves.

name: Stark / Homecoming
look: Clean red and blue panels with dark dividing lines
moves: Rapid web targeting tags several nearby foes
Small spider drone creates a launch opening
tradeoff: Gadget charges and drone asset work keep this out of the first combat experiment.

name: Upgraded — Far From Home
look: Red and black with a small clean chest spider
moves: Spread web shots bind a narrow fan of enemies
Air zip strike converts a bind into a juggle
tradeoff: Multi-shot costs more web capacity and has reduced individual damage.

name: Night Monkey / stealth movie suit
look: Dark tactical clothing and round goggle lenses
moves: Smoke-like dodge breaks an attacker's lock briefly
Ambush kick sets up a fast web restraint
tradeoff: Smoke and awareness mechanics need validation; no permanent invisibility.

name: Integrated — No Way Home
look: Red and black with a large gold spider motif
moves: Alternate web and melee attacks to charge a finisher
Short web shield protects one committed launcher
tradeoff: Repeating attacks loses the benefit; shield has a short active window.

name: Black and Gold — No Way Home
look: Black body, gold lines and detailed exposed tech motif
moves: Timed web catch redirects one projectile
Golden web bind creates a delayed combo opening
tradeoff: These are proposed mechanics, not a claim that this costume grants magic.

name: Raimi / webbed movie suit
look: Rich red and blue, broad pale eyes and raised-web impression
moves: Swing momentum powers a kick finisher
Organic-web theme supports gradual web recovery
tradeoff: Use broad panel contrast; dense raised webbing will alias on DS.

name: Amazing Spider-Man — movie 1
look: Narrow red chest panel, long spider legs, dark movie-inspired lenses
moves: Dodge → web yank → long kick
Fast directional zip cancels a successful web setup
tradeoff: The current cosmetic cleanup does not implement these ability proposals.

name: Amazing Spider-Man — movie 2
look: Classic red and blue with large pale lenses
moves: Spinning air kick follows a web launch
Midair web rebound adds one controlled extension
tradeoff: One rebound per launch prevents infinite air combos.

name: Last Stand
look: Red jacket over dark clothing and a simple mask
moves: Short heavy punches punish close targets
Low-health grit briefly strengthens one counter
tradeoff: Longer recovery and no limitless low-health bonus.

name: Wrestling suit
look: Rough red mask and simple red-blue athletic outfit
moves: Command grab tosses an enemy into a second target
Dropkick ends a short wrestling string
tradeoff: Grabs fail against bosses or oversized enemies without dedicated support.

name: Bombastic Bag-Man
look: Blue Fantastic Four outfit and a paper-bag mask
moves: Taunt baits a predictable strike
Clumsy-looking counter turns the bait into a launch
tradeoff: Paper bag shape needs model work; taunts need bounded enemy behavior.

name: Spider-Clan / manga
look: Stylized red-blue ninja outfit and large goggles
moves: Afterimage dodge enables a fast cross-up kick
Heel-kick barrage ends an acrobatic string
tradeoff: Afterimages are visual flourishes; do not require literal teleportation.

name: Miles Morales — classic
look: Black suit with a red emblem and red mask details
moves: Venom punch launches a target
Camouflage creates one opening for a charged strike
tradeoff: Separate electricity and cloak budgets; no permanent stun loop.

name: Miles — programmable matter
look: Dark body with bright red angular tech patterns
moves: Energy-claw flurry alters the combo ending
Programmable strike changes between launch and knockback
tradeoff: Begin with existing poses and effects before attempting changing geometry.

name: Miles — Purple Reign
look: Purple and green tech colors over a dark base
moves: Decoy draws one enemy's first strike
Charged web mine creates a follow-up launch
tradeoff: A cosmetic prototype comes first; decoys require enemy-targeting research.

name: Miles — Bodega Cat
look: Casual hoodie and backpack with a cat companion
moves: Cat-assisted finisher adds a small combo flourish
Backpack-themed distraction sets up a counter
tradeoff: The cat and backpack require additional model/animation assets.

name: Ghost-Spider / Gwen
look: White hood, white and black body, pink-blue accents
moves: Pirouette kick starts a multi-directional air string
Well-timed dodge gives one extra aerial cancel
tradeoff: Hood is a later silhouette change; cap extra cancels per jump.

name: Silk
look: Black and pale panels, red lower-face covering
moves: Quick web weave binds a target during a melee string
Dodge cancel converts a successful bind into a cross-up
tradeoff: Lower damage per hit; repeated binds build resistance.

name: Spider-Girl — Mayday Parker
look: Red and blue with large pale lenses and a bold spider
moves: Repelling counter pushes a grabbed enemy away
Spider-sense opening strengthens a precise weak-point strike
tradeoff: Timed defense rather than constant passive bonuses.

name: Spider-Woman — Jessica Drew
look: Red and yellow with a distinctive pale forehead/eye motif
moves: Venom bolt interrupts a distant enemy
Short glide closes into an electric melee finisher
tradeoff: Different body proportions and glide behavior make a faithful version more involved.

name: Spider-Man India — Pavitr Prabhakar
look: Red mask and Indian-inspired flowing red-blue outfit
moves: Looping web grab spins a target into another foe
Swinging aerial strike rewards continuous motion
tradeoff: Start with color blocks; flowing cloth and props need later geometry.

name: Spider-UK
look: Union Jack-inspired red, pale and blue pattern
moves: Timed guard stores charge for a shield-breaking strike
Rally burst interrupts a surrounding group
tradeoff: Defensive control trades away long air strings.

name: Chasm — Ben Reilly
look: Purple and green organic-looking suit
moves: Offensive spider-sense counter starts a combo
Goo-energy blade flourish finishes a charged string
tradeoff: Counter must be timed; automatic always-on retaliation would play itself.

name: AracKnight
look: Spider motif with pale hood and Moon Knight-like shapes
moves: Crescent-themed strike ends in a pull-in attack
Moonlit counter earns a short damage window
tradeoff: Effects can precede hood or weapon geometry; proposed mechanics need no story rewrite.

name: Spider-Man 1602
look: Old-world red-blue clothing and a mask
moves: Web feint baits a strike into a riposte
Precise lunge replaces a wide heavy attack
tradeoff: Clothing silhouette and fencing poses are later animation work.

name: Spider-Man 2211
look: Bulky futuristic armor and mechanical arms
moves: Short local slow creates a combo opening
One costly rewind-like escape returns to a recent position
tradeoff: Time/position manipulation is a major engine experiment, not an early feature.

name: Peni Parker / SP//dr-inspired
look: Small red-blue spider mech silhouette
moves: Charged mech pulse controls a short lane
Deployable spider gadget sets up a stomp
tradeoff: A faithful mech needs a new model, skeleton and animations; very ambitious.

name: Spider-Ham-inspired
look: Cartoon red-blue hero with a snout and round ears
moves: Mallet-themed slam bounces an enemy
Rubber-hose dodge leads to a springy air combo
tradeoff: Cartoon silhouette and mallet animations make this a later novelty option.

name: Ultimate Spider-Woman — Jessica clone
look: Red body with a pale spider and long dark hair
moves: Dual organic-web bind feeds a fast kick string
Airborne web pull extends one launch
tradeoff: Hair and body proportions need later model work; avoid unlimited juggle extensions.
